blocks.text: Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon batata hai ke heat energy barabar miqdar ke kaam mein badal sakti hai, magar un sharait par khamosh hai jin ke tahat yeh tabdeeli hoti hai. Doosra qanoon un halaat se mutalliq hai jin mein heat kaam mein badal sakti hai aur heat ke bahao ki simt se.

Rasmi bayan se pehle engine ke asal kaam par ghaur karein. Engine ya system (Fig. 6.8) temperature T1 par heat ke zariye se heat ki miqdar Q1 jazb karta hai; yeh kaam W karta hai aur temperature T2 par kam temperature ke reservoir ko heat Q2 nikalta hai. Chunke working substance cyclic amal se guzarta hai jis mein aakhir apni ibtidai halat par wapas aata hai, internal energy ki tabdeeli sifr hai; is liye pehle qanoon se khalis kiya kaam khalis jazb heat ke barabar hai: W = Q1 - Q2. Amal mein motor car ka petrol engine jalte eendhan se heat leta hai, is energy ka ek hissa mechanical energy ya kaam mein badalta hai aur baqi fiza mein nikal deta hai; dekha gaya hai ke petrol engines taqreeban 25% aur diesel engines 35 se 40% dastiyab heat energy kaam mein badalte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar Hot reservoir T1 ka dabba; us se chaura laal teer Q1 neeche narangi sitare Heat engine mein. Engine se daen taraf hari patti Output Work = W mur kar teer banti hai. Engine se patli neeli patti Q2 neeche Cold reservoir T2 ke dabbe mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.8: Heat engine ka khaaka. Engine garam reservoir se heat Q1 leta hai, thande reservoir ko Q2 deta hai aur kaam W karta hai (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab mein 'Fig. 6.10' chhapa hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein is figure ke neeche ghalti se 'Fig. 6.10' chhapa hai, jabke text ise Fig. 6.8 kehta hai (Fig. 6.10 refrigerator hai). Diagram ka matlab: garam reservoir se aane wali heat Q1 ka kuch hissa kaam W banta hai aur baqi Q2 thande reservoir ko jati hai, is liye W = Q1 - Q2.

blocks.title: Doosra qanoon (Lord Kelvin ka bayan)
blocks.text: Doosra qanoon in mushahidat par mabni rasmi bayan hai aur kai tareeqon se bayan ho sakta hai. Heat engine ke kaam par mabni Lord Kelvin ke bayan ke mutabiq: aisa amal banana namumkin hai jo ek akele reservoir se li gayi heat ko working system mein koi tabdeeli chhore baghair poori tarah kaam mein badal de.

Is ka matlab hai ke ek akela heat reservoir, chahe us mein kitni hi energy ho, koi kaam karne par majboor nahi kiya ja sakta. Yeh samandaron aur hamari fiza ke liye sach hai, jin mein heat energy ki bari miqdar hai magar mufeed mechanical kaam mein nahi badli ja sakti. Doosre qanoon ke nateeje ke taur par heat ko kaam mein badalne ke liye mukhtalif temperatures par do ajsam zaroori hain: heat engine ke kaam ke liye zyada temperature par heat ka zariya (source) aur kam temperature par sink hona chahiye jise heat nikali ja sake. Samandaron aur fiza ki heat istemal na kar sakne ki wajah yeh hai ke dono mein se kisi se kam temperature par koi reservoir nahi. Tidbits box mein dikhaya amal, ek temperature ke zariye se heat poori tarah kaam mein badalna, namumkin hai.

blocks.alt: Akela laal reservoir Temperature T; us se narangi patti Heat in, neeche teer ke sath, kale daire Heat engine mein, jis ki nikalti patti par work likha hai. Poore khaake par neela mamnu (prohibition) nishan hai jis ke kinare par IMPOSSIBLE likha hai.
blocks.caption: Tidbits (PDF page 130): yahan dikhaya amal na-mumkin hai; ek hi temperature ke zariye ki heat poori kaam mein nahi badal sakti (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh Kelvin ka bayan hai: sirf ek reservoir se heat le kar saari ki saari kaam mein badalna na-mumkin hai. Engine ko kaam karne ke liye ek thanda reservoir (sink) bhi chahiye jahan kuch heat chhodi jaye, jaisa Figure 6.8 mein.

blocks.prompt: Doosra qanoon do mukhtalif shakalon mein bayan karein, aur batayein ke kya cyclic reversible engine ek temperature par heat jazb kar ke use poori tarah kaam mein badal sakta hai (short questions 6.3, 6.9).
blocks.explanation: Kelvin: koi amal ek akele reservoir se li heat ko working system mein tabdeeli chhore baghair poori tarah kaam mein nahi badal sakta. Clausius: heat khud ba khud thande se garam jism ki taraf nahi beh sakti. Entropy ki shakal: qudrati amal us simt mein jata hai jo system jama mahol ki entropy barhaye. Nahi: cyclic engine ko kuch heat thande sink ko deni parti hai, warna yeh Kelvin ke bayan ki khilaf-warzi hoga; akela source use nahi chala sakta.

items: Engine: T1 par Q1 jazb, W karta, T2 par Q2 nikalta; W = Q1 - Q2 (petrol taqreeban 25%, diesel 35 se 40%). Kelvin: akele reservoir ki heat poori tarah kaam nahi ban sakti; mukhtalif temperatures par source aur sink zaroori, to samandar aur fiza engine nahi chala sakte.
